findings.fix_direction: Make stop notification best effort; always perform owned cleanup and return terminal trace, known usage and a failure reason without repeating a failing stop write.
findings.limits: No real CLI fault run or measured denominator inflation; the missing return is observed, CLI early abort is a control-flow inference.
findings.proof: Two original CPU cases (normal final and raw parse failure), injecting only parent stop.json EIO; both generated outputs with known 13 input / 9 output token counters, both raised OSError with no HarnessResult.
findings.summary: Failure to write the parent-owned stop packet re-enters finish and raises again before returning terminal evidence; finally still reaps the real child.

findings.fix_direction: Track process reaping, handle closure and temporary-directory cleanup separately; repeated close must stay valid after any cleanup failure and preserve terminal result plus the actual cleanup error.
findings.proof: Two independently authored CPU cases on the frozen candidate; directory cleanup EIO after actual process exit 0 and handle close caused ValueError: process object is closed. Directory remained until explicit review-only safety cleanup.
findings.provenance: S0 reported the same failure category while the review was active; the review independently reproduced it without reading E1 uncommitted tests or adopting a fix.
findings.summary: Temporary-directory cleanup can raise after process.close() but before the closed flag, so later cleanup re-enters a closed Process, masks the original error and prevents terminal evidence.

findings.fix_direction: Validate an ordered pending-call sequence before strategy matching; reject unreliable order with unknown without changing the frozen schema.

findings.proof: Start from an independently authored successful case, swap execution and observation, preserve identities and monotonic latency, renumber indices and validate every wire event; expected unknown, observed success.
findings.summary: Separately flattening calls and observations loses causal order; a wire-valid trace with observation before execution still scores success.

import importlib,importlib.metadata,importlib.util,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
names=['toolalign.tools','toolalign.tools.__main__','toolalign.tools._json',
       'toolalign.tools.catalog','toolalign.tools.executor','toolalign.tools.isolation',
       'toolalign.tools.registry','toolalign.tools.scripted','toolalign.evaluation.harness',
       'toolalign.evaluation.oracles','toolalign.evaluation.oracles.semantic']
for name in names:
    module=importlib.import_module(name)
    assert Path(module.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(sys.prefix).resolve())
for name in ('mlx','mlx_lm','torch','transformers'):
    assert name not in sys.modules and importlib.util.find_spec(name) is None
print(json.dumps({'python_version':sys.version.split()[0], 'isolated_flag':sys.flags.isolated,
                  'p03_modules_inside_installed_prefix':names,'model_packages_available':[],
